preview.plugin.name: File preview
preview.tab.label: Preview
preview.empty.noPath: This preview tab has no file path (close it and pick a file from the tree again).
preview.empty.noPatchPath: This patch tab has no file path (close it and click again from the tool card).
preview.systemTip.on: Open with the system default app.
preview.systemTip.off: This comes from the desktop shell's native bridge; browsers don't have it.
preview.patch.openTip: Open the current file in preview (content is the snapshot at edit time).
preview.patch.gone: This patch is gone (diff snapshots do not survive an app restart or session switch). Click "Open" to see the file's current content.
preview.patch.truncated: Large change: only the first part is shown (the file's current content is authoritative).
preview.tooLarge: File too large ({size}); only files under 10MB can be previewed.
preview.binary: Binary file ({size}); preview is not supported.
preview.unknownType: Files like this ({mime}, {size}) cannot be previewed here; use "Open externally" to view them.
